Title: Growth Marketing Manager – Paid Media & Klaviyo (AI-First)
Type: Full-time contractor
Seniority: Mid-level
Salary: USD 55,000–70,000/year + performance bonus
Location: Remote — Worldwide, excluding the United States, Canada, United Kingdom and Western Europe. Candidates must be available for at least four hours of overlap with Pacific Time.

About Nectar Life. We're a vertically integrated bath and body brand: handmade, vegan and cruelty-free. We make everything in our own 26,000 sq ft Las Vegas factory and sell it in our own stores on the Las Vegas Strip, Downtown Disney, Universal CityWalk and Waikiki, and online through Shopify.

The role. We're bringing growth in-house. You'll replace our paid-ads agency and own customer acquisition and retention end to end, reporting to the CEO. Your work will move sales visibly, and you'll help build our AI creative workflows from the ground up.

Must-haves (we screen for both first):

  • 3+ years of hands-on Meta Ads Manager work for ecommerce or DTC brands: you built, tested and scaled the campaigns yourself and can show spend, ROAS and CPA.

  • Hands-on Klaviyo: email and SMS flows, segmentation and campaigns you built, with revenue to show for them.

What you'll do:

  • Run Meta and TikTok ads: budgets, audiences, creative testing, scaling winners.

  • Run Klaviyo retention: welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase and win-back flows, plus weekly sends.

  • Produce ad creative with AI tools (image, video, copy), then edit it to match our brand and keep product details accurate.

  • Report weekly on what worked, what didn't and what's next.

You'll stand out if you: have beauty, skincare, fragrance or gifting experience; edit short-form video; build automations with Claude, n8n or Make.

Hours: at least 4 hours overlap with 9am–5pm US Pacific.

Application questions:

  1. Upload a Meta Ads Manager screenshot of campaigns you ran (spend, purchases, ROAS visible).

  2. Upload a screenshot of a Klaviyo flow you built, with its revenue or conversion stats.

  3. Link one ad you made with AI tools and name the tools.

Marketing Strategist

Reports To: Senior Growth Strategist or Director of Outcomes

Are you a proactive, confident, independent and business-minded strategist?
Are you an analytical thinker who merges clever ideas with actual data to generate proven marketing outcomes?
Are you comfortable owning outcomes and carrying the weight of client success on your shoulders?

If so, as a Marketing Strategist for RedRover, you’ll sit at the intersection of strategy, client success and execution. This is a role for top-notch talent who doesn’t just understand marketing, but understands marketing in the context of business performance. We are looking for top-notch talent to join our team.

At RedRover, we help B2B companies grow through smart strategy, strong execution, and marketing that drives real business results. We are looking for a Marketing Strategist who can jump into client accounts, think strategically, collaborate across teams, and help our clients achieve their goals.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy, client success, and execution. You'll be involved early in our GO Plan process, helping shape marketing strategies and recommendations that align with client objectives. From there, you'll partner with Account Directors and internal teams to ensure those strategies are executed effectively and continue to deliver results over time.

Our clients span multiple industries, so we're looking for someone who is curious, adaptable, and comfortable learning new businesses quickly. You should be equally comfortable discussing high-level strategy with a client and diving into campaign performance data to identify opportunities for improvement.

What You'll Do

  • Work alongside the Senior Manager of Strategy to develop client marketing strategies and GO Plans.
  • Support Account Directors in driving client success and achieving business objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve performance, increase lead generation, and drive measurable ROI.
  • Collaborate with teams across strategy, sales, client services, digital marketing, and outcomes to ensure work is aligned and moving forward.
  • Review campaign performance and provide recommendations based on data and insights.
  • Help guide marketing programs that may include paid media, SEO, content marketing, email marketing, lead nurturing, marketing automation, social media, and sales enablement.
  • Stay current on B2B marketing trends, technologies, and best practices.
  • Participate in client meetings and contribute strategic recommendations and ideas.

What We're Looking For

  • A strong background in B2B marketing with experience developing and executing marketing strategies.
  • Deep knowledge of digital marketing channels including PPC, SEO, email marketing, content marketing, social media, and marketing automation.
  • Strong understanding of how marketing contributes to pipeline growth and revenue generation.
  • Experience using HubSpot and other CRM or marketing automation platforms.
  • Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and turn insights into action.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and clients.
  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with cross functional teams.

Bonus Points For

  • Agency experience.
  • HubSpot certifications or other relevant marketing certifications.
  • Experience supporting clients across multiple industries.

Why RedRover

We're a team of marketers who care deeply about our clients, our work, and each other. You'll have the opportunity to work with a variety of B2B companies, contribute to meaningful growth initiatives, and collaborate with talented teammates who are passionate about delivering great results.

If you love marketing, enjoy solving complex business challenges, and want to be part of a team that values both strategy and execution, we'd love to meet you.

  • Assist with organizing promotional events
  • Coordinate with the Marketing Design and Content teams to create advertising material (e.g. brochures and newsletters)

  • Prepare regular sales forecasting reports

Our Forums present a unique opportunity to link together asset managers and investors to achieve premium return on time and investment. Through our portfolio of conferences, we work to meet the dynamic needs of our specialized audiences across the geographies we serve.

Markets group has grown into the largest and most successful conference organizer in the world with over 100 professionals operating out of New York, London, and Singapore.

We are looking for a Marketing Manager to help plan and implement our marketing and advertising activities.

For this role, you should understand the full marketing mix and be familiar with ways to analyse market research and customers’ behaviour. You should also be able to create spreadsheets and analyse quantitative data to interpret ROI and KPI metrics.

Ultimately, you should help us achieve our business goals through building strong marketing campaigns.

Who We Are:

We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. Our vision is to be recognized as the most valued and respected private growth marketing firm in the world–with a scalable brand, culture and services. Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

**We support 100% remote, in-office, or hybrid work styles for anyone legally eligible to work in the U.S.

A day in the life:

As an Associate Account Director, you will serve as the primary strategic partner for your clients on a day-to-day basis, owning the narrative around performance, identifying growth opportunities, and ensuring all marketing efforts ladder up to business objectives. A successful candidate is a strong cross-channel marketer and communicator who can confidently translate data into insights, guide internal teams, and build trust with clients. This is a critical role in ensuring accounts are not only running efficiently, but driving meaningful business impact. As an Associate Account Director (AAD), you will act as the day-to-day strategic lead for CPG clients, ensuring marketing efforts are aligned to revenue growth across DTC, retail, and Amazon ecosystems—not just individual channel performance.

You will work closely with client stakeholders across eCommerce, retail, and brand teams, helping navigate tradeoffs between channels, product launches, and campaign strategy. This role requires comfort discussing channel mix, retail dynamics, Amazon performance, and omnichannel measurement. You’ll partner with Project Managers to ensure execution stays on track, while collaborating with the Account Director to refine quarterly strategy and long-term growth plans.

Responsibilities:

  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department
  • Lead weekly client calls on larger accounts; support PM-led calls on smaller accounts — own the performance narrative either way
  • Translate Power Circuit roadmap outputs into weekly account priorities; flag when execution is drifting from the strategy
  • Track performance across DTC, retail media, and Amazon ecosystems; identify cross-channel dynamics and surface insights to the client and AD
  • Coordinate paid, SEO, content, influencer, and creative teams around a unified account strategy
  • Advise on channel mix and investment allocation across DTC, retail, and Amazon; flag when channels are cannibalizing rather than reinforcing each other
  • Support the AD on quarterly strategy, renewal prep, and service expansion conversations
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships; contribute to ≥90% retention across your accounts
  • Work in Iris and nova daily; use performance data to surface issues before clients raise them; maintain Pulse cadence at 100%

Role Requirements:

  • 4–7 years in CPG, eCommerce, or retail marketing, with experience managing client relationships day-to-day
  • Familiar with the CPG channel landscape: DTC, retail media, and Amazon basics — ASIN architecture, sponsored vs. organic, retail partner dynamics
  • Understands omnichannel measurement at a working level — knows what MMM and incrementality testing are and when they matter
  • Cross-channel fluency across paid, SEO, content, and influencer — you don't need to be an expert in all of them, but you need to know when something's off
  • Comfortable presenting to director and VP-level stakeholders, including brand-strong clients who have opinions that predate the data
  • Strong written and verbal communication; can translate complex channel dynamics into a clear client narrative

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Expansion to Churn Ratio (ETCR)
  • Net MRR across portfolio
  • Client NPS (8+ avg)
  • Monthly Service Expansion pipeline generation
  • Power Circuit Certification (annual)

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Team Coaching and Development
  • Marketing Strategy, Development and Execution
  • Client Retention and Client Revenue Growth

Benefits & Perks:

  • Base salary + commission opportunities
  • Robust Medical, Dental, Vision insurance plans with up to 100% employer contribution towards employee monthly premium
  • 401(k) plan - 4% employer contribution matching
  • Unlimited Time Off available on day one
  • Up to 4 hours per quarter for paid Volunteer Time Off (VTO) towards philanthropic endeavors
  • Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
  • A one time $100 USD Work From Home (WFH) stipend automatically added to your first paycheck
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • 12 observed United States national holidays + 2 mental health recharge days per year
  • Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
  • Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)
  • Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance
  • Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives
